title: Analyst Training — Producing a Digital Footprint Report
subtitle: Internal onboarding for the social-analyzer reporting workflow
author: <Your business name>

slides.title: Learning objectives
bullets: Run product-readiness-check and read its verdict
Open an engagement and run a scan with scan.sh
Produce a DRAFT report, request owner approval, produce FINAL
Never bypass a gate: production, publication, spending, customer_communication

slides.title: Step 1 — Readiness
bullets: node agents/skills/product-readiness-check/run.mjs
READY / READY WITH CAVEATS → proceed; NOT READY → stop and escalate
Common caveat: NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS on proxied networks
Common caveat: firefox/tesseract missing → fast mode only
slides.notes: Show the readiness.md table. Explain WARN vs FAIL.

slides.title: Step 2 — Open the engagement
bullets: ledger.py add engagement --actor owner:<name> -f customer=… -f subject=… -f purpose=…
Purpose must be a lawful purpose stated by the customer
Copy the eng-… id; everything else references it

slides.title: Step 3 — Scan
bullets: agents/skills/footprint-report-producer/scan.sh <eng-id> <username> "<sites|all>"
Uses the existing app.js — do not modify detection logic
Output: 10_Engagements/<eng-id>/scan-<username>.json

slides.title: Rules you must not break
bullets: Agents cannot record approvals (ledger refuses agent:/bot: actors)
No FINAL without production approval
No sending, posting or paying from any skill
Verify the ledger weekly: ledger.py verify

slides.title: Exercise
bullets: Run the full flow for identifier 'johndoe' on sites 'github reddit'
Expected: 1 detected (github, 100%), reddit unreachable in fast mode
Submit the DRAFT path and ledger record id
